name: Bolstering Our Defenses
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.

It is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
narrative.objectives: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is good news, adventurer. It will be a constant struggle here in the Plaguelands until we have fully driven back the forces of the Alliance.

Until that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.
narrative.requestItemsText:
They must be fools to think that we would allow them to establish bases so close to one of our capitals.

We will bleed their numbers until they turn tail and retreat back to the south.
